title: Independent Living Residency Agreement — Second Occupants and Transfers Between Apartments
content:
## Second occupants

1. A second occupant may be added only where the maximum occupants of the apartment type is 2 and the second occupant is at least the second-occupant minimum age on the day they move in.
2. From the day a second occupant moves in, the second person fee of the apartment type is billed (prorated for the first month), and the second-occupant community fee of the apartment type is charged each time a second occupant moves in.
3. When a second occupant leaves or dies, the occupancy becomes single and the second person fee ends on the day they leave or the date of death, with the days after it returned as a move-out proration credit.
4. Occupancy changes may be recorded while the residency is in active or notice given status.

## Apartment transfers

5. An apartment transfer is made only at the resident's signed request to a vacant apartment in the same community, and only while the residency is active.
6. The monthly service fee for the new apartment is the published base monthly service fee of the new apartment type on the transfer date, effective on the day the resident takes possession, and an apartment transfer fee of the type moved into is charged; the new-resident rate guarantee does not restart.
7. A transfer to a Studio is possible only at single occupancy.

## Status conditions side by side

| Residency status | Occupancy change | Apartment transfer |
|---|---|---|
| Active | May be recorded | May be made |
| Notice given | May be recorded | Not made |
| Any other status | Not recorded | Not made |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- **Studio.** A resident in an Independent Living Studio cannot add a second occupant, because the maximum occupants of a Studio is 1.
- **One-Bedroom.** A 57-year-old spouse moving into an Independent Living One-Bedroom meets a second-occupant minimum age of 55; the second person fee is billed from the move-in day, prorated for that first month, and the second-occupant community fee is charged.
- **Transfer to a larger apartment.** A resident moving at their own signed request from a One-Bedroom to a vacant Two-Bedroom in the same community pays the Two-Bedroom's published base monthly service fee from the day they take possession, and the transfer fee of the Two-Bedroom; the date their rate guarantee ends does not change.
